input.task: What is the main heading on this page?

provenance: M43/ADR-035 Decision 1. Every loop turn's observation must carry the viewport screenshot, and the screenshot must be the trace's own step evidence — the same file, not a parallel pipeline. `driver_screenshots` is graded at driver-call time by the recording driver, which stats the file the observation names and reads its PNG header, so a phantom filename or a never-captured image is red, not a passing claim. `trace_screenshots` grades the other half: the pre-plan navigate record used to hardcode `screenshot: null`, and in loop mode the first turn now fills it — entry [0] is the load-bearing one. Red against the pre-implementation tree; the evidence was reconstructed post-hoc after a session interruption, and docs/evals/m43-red-first-ledger.md says so in those words rather than claiming this case was watched red as it was written.

triage.note: the model cannot look at a page nobody photographed; the trace cannot show what the model saw unless the same file is its evidence.
